svg.text: Decoupling Heavy Offline Deep RL (Python/SB3) from Sub-Millisecond Native Runtime Neural Inference (Godot 4.x / Pure GDScript)
• Stochastic simulation of player skill drift across 30 sequential levels
• Simulates novice, intermediate, and expert combat capability curves
• Injects dynamic fatigue, damage variance, and clearance-rate anomalies
• Training Horizon: 300,000 timesteps | Learning Rate: 3e-4 | Minibatch: 256
Target Pace: T* = 45.0s | Pacing Error: time_err = |(T/N) - 45s| / 45s
Boredom Penalty: -0.3 if deaths=0 and t_room < 22.5s (Forces Escalation)
• Injects synthetic boundary conditions (infinite deaths, instant clear, AFK)
• Validates monotonicity: difficulty de-escalates under struggle, scales under mastery
Confirms zero gradient saturation across continuous action intervals [-1, 1]
• Exports floats for Layer 1 (8x64, 64), Layer 2 (64x64, 64), Layer 3 (64x8, 8)
Outputs clean portable JSON file (< 120 KB, 5,256 total float parameters)
The Python training process runs 100% offline. It can be trained on a high-performance
workstation or GPU cluster, and produces a single, tiny, deterministic data file.
NO Python binaries, NO PyTorch libraries, and NO CUDA drivers are shipped with the game.
Captured at level boundary upon exit: Δt = (time - start_time) / 1000s, Δdeaths, Δdamage
Local Data Persistence: user://telemetry.db (SQLite Embedded | Zero Network Transmissions)
Maps rolling state into s_t ∈ [0, 1]^8: [norm_time, norm_deaths, norm_dmg_ratio, norm_hp,
Formula: clamp((val - min) / (max - min), 0.0, 1.0) | Strict mathematical bounds guarantee stability
• Executed natively in GDScript via Vector-Matrix Dot Products: Sub-Millisecond (< 0.5ms)
• Deterministic Fallback (_fallback_heuristic): Activates if weights file is missing
• Complete Self-Containment: Shipped desktop client requires ZERO Python or PyTorch
Measured Performance: Outperforms local REST API by 100x (< 0.5ms vs ~50ms roundtrip)
Adversary E: HP [20, 120], Dmg [5, 50], Speed [60, 220 px/s], Aggro [100, 450 px]
Modifiers M: Hazard Density [0.05, 0.80], Resource Scarcity [0.10, 0.90]
Macro Space: Target Rooms [5, 9], Softmax Archetype Distribution Complexity
• Frontier random-walk graph synthesis: 5 to 9 connected chambers (START ──► EXIT)
• Softmax Archetype Sampling: Grunts, Spitters, Skirmishers, Brutes, Pyromancers
• Guaranteed Unbroken Traversal via A* Pathfinding: Solvability Rate ≥ 95%
6. Live Defense Overlay & Feature Attribution XAI (DefenseOverlay.gd)
• Glass-Box Attribution: Difficulty Score DS ∈ [0, 100] = Σ w_k · x_k_norm
• Displays Top-3 Parameter Drivers on HUD: e.g., 35% Enemy Dmg, 25% Traps, 20% Speed
• Interactive Faculty Inspection: Real-time parameter override sliders & Auto-Kill toggle
DISPROVED ALTERNATIVE: Local Python REST Inference Server (FastAPI)
Execution Latency: ~50ms HTTP localhost loopback penalty introduces stutter between rooms
Deployment Bloat: Shipped client requires bundled Python runtime, PyTorch wheels (> 2.5 GB)
Brittle Failure: If background Python server crashes, game client permanently locks up
FORGE SELECTED SOLUTION: Embedded Pure GDScript Neural Forward Pass
Zero Execution Latency: < 0.5ms native GDScript vector dot products in same memory space
Ultra-Lightweight Packaging: Standalone Windows .exe requires ONLY policy_weights.json (< 120 KB)
Deterministic Crash Resilience: Automated mathematical fallback heuristic guarantees continuous play
